remarks: Elegant and light-filled corner residence offering over 1,200 square feet of refined living space. This beautifully updated two-bedroom, two-bath condominium features a sophisticated open-concept layout with a renovated kitchen showcasing granite countertops and stainless-steel appliances that seamlessly flow into the spacious living and dining areas. Numerous windows capture multiple sunlit exposures and open to an oversized screened-in balcony-ideal for morning coffee. The serene primary suite includes a renovated en-suite bath and generous closets, complemented by a second bedroom with walk-in closet and a second renovated bath. Residents enjoy a well-appointed fitness center with sauna, assigned garage parking, abundant guest parking, storage unit and a prime location just 1 mile from downtown Stamford's shopping, dining, and transportation. A perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and understated luxury.
